translations.web: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.
translations.bsb: This is My covenant with you and your descendants after you, which you are to keep: Every male among you must be circumcised.
translations.kjv: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.
